name: Hookline Dockworker Sling Pack
description:
A single-strap sling pack built for the loading docks and transit corridors of Circuit. Heavy-gauge recycled polyweave shell in faded slate-green, reinforced at stress points with double-stitched nylon tape. The main compartment opens wide with a U-zip; a chest-mounted buckle keeps it locked tight during heavy movement.

The strap is padded with dense foam wrapped in moisture-wicking mesh. A reflective strip runs the full length for dock-floor visibility. Hard-use scarring, frayed strap edges, and faded stenciling from previous owners are common — this bag passes through many hands.
functionality: Main compartment fits a shift's worth of tools, food, and personal gear. External compression straps secure bulky items. Chest buckle prevents swing during physical labor. Reflective strip meets Circuit dock safety requirements.
what_it_says: You carry your whole life on one shoulder and you keep moving.
story_hooks: The previous owner's name is still stenciled inside the flap — and that person was reported missing six weeks ago.
A hidden inner seam pocket contains a folded note written in a creole of Yoruba and Korean — a message someone needed to survive.
A dock inspector flags the bag's reflective strip as non-compliant with new Helix Corp safety rebranding — the worker must pay for a replacement or lose shift access.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian single-strap sling pack with a distinctly worn, hand-me-down aesthetic. The silhouette is compact and angled, sitting comfortably across the torso from shoulder to hip. Projects working-class durability and practical street utility.
physical_description.fit: Adjustable strap length accommodates various body types; sits snug against the ribs during movement, distributes weight evenly across the shoulder and chest for dock labor and transit navigation.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-gauge recycled polyweave shell—salvaged synthetic fibers compressed and bonded. Nylon reinforcement tape. Padded strap core of dense EVA foam wrapped in moisture-wicking mesh.
physical_description.texture: Shell is slightly stiff and grainy, with visible seams and stress creasing from repeated use. Strap padding is soft but slightly tacky from sweat absorption. Double-stitched seams create subtle ridges.
physical_description.color_scheme: Faded slate-green primary color with cream-colored nylon reinforcement tape at corners and stress points. Reflective silver strip runs the full strap length. Older stencil markings—worn logos, previous owner tags—visible in ghost-white on the shell.
physical_description.closures: Wide U-zip main compartment opening. Magnetic chest buckle for quick-access security during heavy dock work. Friction-fit compression straps optional.
distinctive_features: Reflective strip full-length on strap for dock-floor safety
Double-stitched nylon reinforcement at all seams and stress corners
U-zip main compartment with wide throat opening
Visible wear scarring, frayed strap edges, faded stencil marks from previous owners
Padded moisture-wicking strap—designed for sweaty dock conditions
Hard-use patina: creasing, slight discoloration, evidence of multiple hands
physical_description.cultural_context: Circuit dock workers, transit couriers, ungoverned zone scavengers. Signals practical labor, minimal corporate affiliation, resourcefulness. A pack that's been through cycles of ownership—repurposed, repaired, respected.
physical_description.condition_typical: Intentionally weathered and broken-in. Frayed edges, visible creasing, ghost-marks from old stickers or paint. Signs of repair (patched seams, reinforced stress points). Patina is worn but structurally sound—this is a pack that's proven itself.
